changeSet.author: credesal
changeSet.comment: Correct the 0414 annual-closing label and keep the income statement exclusion on native voucher metadata.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE credesal_gl_voucher voucher SET posting_category = 'CLOSING' WHERE voucher.posting_category = 'OPENING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM acc_gl_journal_entry journal JOIN credesal_arissto_gl_journal_line source_line ON source_line.target_journal_entry_id = journal.id JOIN credesal_arissto_gl_journal provenance ON provenance.id = source_line.journal_provenance_id WHERE journal.voucher_id = voucher.id AND provenance.source_journal_type = '003' );
UPDATE stretchy_report SET report_sql = REPLACE(report_sql, 'opening_voucher.posting_category = ''OPENING''', 'opening_voucher.posting_category IN (''OPENING'',''CLOSING'')') WHERE report_name = 'Estado de Resultados Consolidado' AND report_sql LIKE '%opening_voucher.posting_category = ''OPENING''%';
